content.short: StakeStone is an omnichain liquid staking protocol that provides highly liquid, yield-bearing assets via STONE.
content.description: StakeStone is a leading omnichain liquid staking protocol designed to provide users with a highly liquid and composable yield-bearing asset, STONE. Built on LayerZero technology, STONE is an Omnichain Fungible Token (OFT) that can be seamlessly bridged across multiple networks—including Mantle, Linea, and Scroll—without losing its yield-accruing properties. The protocol optimizes returns by dynamically allocating staked ETH into a diversified selection of blue-chip liquid staking derivatives and restaking strategies on EigenLayer, ensuring participants earn multiple layers of yield.
content.meta: StakeStone provides omnichain liquid staking through the yield-bearing STONE token. Discover StakeStone and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
